name: Happy's Gifts and Apparel
old_description: Elevate your Mercer County business with professional custom embroidery from Happy's Gifts and Apparel in Hazen, ND. Perfect for logos on polos, hats, jackets, aprons, and team uniforms. Ideal for oil field crews, schools, churches, farms, and events in Beulah, Hazen, and Stanton.
about:
Happy's Gifts and Apparel operates from a home-based shop in Hazen, North Dakota, serving Mercer County and surrounding communities. The business was started about five years ago by Keith and Morgan, a husband-and-wife team who run the operation as a Christian, family-owned enterprise. Keith, a paramedic of over ten years, began with a miter saw crafting custom woodworking pieces for local customers; demand grew after they added a laser engraver and later an embroidery machine, turning a side project into a full-time custom shop.

The company provides custom embroidery, laser engraving and cutting, screen-printed and embroidered apparel (t‑shirts, polos, hats, hoodies), laser‑engraved stainless‑steel tumblers, and a range of promotional products such as keychains, coozies, trays, awards and magnets. All work is done in‑house with low minimum orders and wholesale pricing for volumes typically ranging from 10 to 100+ pieces. Free design proofs are offered on every project.

Primary customers include oil‑field crews, schools, churches, farms and local businesses in Beulah, Hazen, Stanton and Washburn. The shop also serves event organizers needing tradeshow giveaways, employee‑recognition awards and client‑appreciation gifts, as well as families seeking personalized keepsakes.

Happy's emphasizes local, personal service: customers work directly with the makers, receive free design assistance, and can pick up orders in Hazen to avoid shipping delays. The owners highlight durable stitching and engraving built for North Dakota conditions, competitive wholesale rates, and the convenience of a single source for apparel, drinkware, awards and promotional items.
